Release notes

What changed in each build of Claimball. Claimball is still in testing and has not been released to the public yet.

Beta 1.0.0 · 2026-11-12

Build 27

A TestFlight internal test build, not released to the public yet.

  • You can now change the app language yourself in Settings.

Beta 1.0.0 · 2026-11-12

Build 26

A TestFlight internal test build, not released to the public yet.

  • The app now supports 12 languages, adding Thai, Vietnamese and Turkish, and Portuguese is now Brazilian Portuguese.
  • The language list has been tidied up. Languages we no longer support are removed from the list.

Beta 1.0.0 · 2026-11-11

Build 25

A TestFlight internal test build, not released to the public yet.

  • No changes to gameplay. We updated how release notes are prepared and published behind the scenes.

Beta 1.0.0 · 2026-11-07

Build 24

A TestFlight internal test build, not released to the public yet.

  • iCloud: your records, daily challenges and season cups now continue too.

Beta 1.0.0 · 2026-11-07

Build 23

A TestFlight internal test build, not released to the public yet.

  • Continue with iCloud: on iPhone and iPad signed in to the same Apple ID, your progress picks up where you left off — it now also syncs when you return to the app.

Beta 1.0.0 · 2026-11-07

Build 22

A TestFlight internal test build, not released to the public yet.

  • Hit feel: conceding a point now shakes the screen lightly with a haptic tap, and the end of a match has its own vibration for a win and a loss.
  • Smash ready cue: when the smash gauge fills up, the paddle flashes with a sparkle and a light tap so you know it's time.
  • New daily challenge "Rally party": a slower ball that speeds up gently, so you can keep the rally going.

Beta 1.0.0 · 2026-11-06

Build 21

A TestFlight internal test build, not released to the public yet.

  • Landscape support: on phones you can now rotate to a wide board with compact side panels. Your match keeps its state and pauses automatically when you rotate.
  • New "Screen orientation" setting: choose auto-rotate, portrait only or landscape only.
  • Support the maker: three optional one-time tips in Settings. They are just a thank-you and change nothing in the game.

Beta 1.0.0 · 2026-11-06

Build 20

A TestFlight internal test build, not released to the public yet.

  • Behind-the-scenes cleanup: the shared internal kit now comes from a versioned private repository instead of a copy inside the game. Nothing changes in how the game looks or plays, and your saved data works exactly as before.

Beta 1.0.0 · 2026-11-06

Build 19

A TestFlight internal test build, not released to the public yet.

  • Behind-the-scenes cleanup: shared building blocks (screen sizing, saved-data reading, version and link handling, crash guard) now come from a common internal kit instead of being copied into the game.
  • Nothing noticeable changes in how the game looks or plays in this build — saved data, nicknames and the Release Notes link work exactly as before.

Beta 1.0.0 · 2026-11-05

Build 18

A TestFlight internal test build, not released to the public yet.

  • On iPad, wide screens get a dedicated layout: the board sits in the center with panels on both sides, and the menu uses two columns.
  • Release Notes now opens in a sheet that slides up inside the app instead of switching to your browser.

Beta 1.0.0 · 2026-11-05

Build 17

A TestFlight internal test build, not released to the public yet.

  • Behind-the-scenes stability work: the game now guards against unexpected errors and can still start if saved data fails to load, plus added checks for accessibility guidelines.
  • Nothing noticeable changes in how the game looks or plays in this build.

Beta 1.0.0 · 2026-11-05

Build 16

A TestFlight internal test build, not released to the public yet.

  • Behind-the-scenes quality work: we added tests that check that records merge safely when synced across your devices through iCloud, and a tool for measuring performance.
  • Nothing changes in how the game looks or plays in this build.

Beta 1.0.0 · 2026-11-03

Build 15

A TestFlight internal test build, not released to the public yet.

  • New My Stats screen: your wins, draws and losses, record against each opponent, and your longest rally — kept only on your device.
  • Background music: three original tracks (menu, match, and a faster fever tempo), plus a music on/off toggle in Settings.

Beta 1.0.0 · 2026-11-03

Build 14

A TestFlight internal test build, not released to the public yet.

  • A short How to play guide of three cards now greets you on your first match.
  • The game screen can now be read aloud with VoiceOver, so every part of a match is announced.
  • Large text sizes and small screens no longer cut off or overflow the layout.
  • The layout now fits iPad and other tablets properly.
  • The game starts normally even if saved data is damaged.
  • Added an automatic check that keeps translations safe and complete in all 13 languages.
  • Preparing for Android: themed icon and per-app language support (Android is coming soon).

Beta 1.0.0 · 2026-11-03

Build 13

A TestFlight internal test build, not released to the public yet.

  • A tie is now a draw. If both players hold the same number of cells at the end, the result screen says Draw instead of showing a loss.
  • Sudden death is fairer: whoever scores the next point wins only by being ahead on cells, however that point is scored.
  • The nickname and iCloud hints now describe exactly what is shared and what stays on your device.
  • Added the privacy information file Apple requires for apps.

Beta 1.0.0 · 2026-11-01

Build 10

A TestFlight internal test build, not released to the public yet.

  • Four more languages: Indonesian, Russian, Arabic and Hindi.
  • The Release Notes link on the first screen now opens the page in your language, at the notes for the version you are playing.

Beta 1.0.0 · 2026-11-01

Build 9

A TestFlight internal test build, not released to the public yet.

  • A second look for the game: Notebook, a paper-and-grid-notebook style that matches the Claimball website.
  • Pick Classic or Notebook in Settings, at the bottom of the settings card. You can switch any time, even in the middle of a session, and nothing restarts.
  • Classic stays the default, so the game looks the same until you change it.
  • Your theme choice is saved on each device (it is not shared through iCloud), so a phone and a tablet can use different looks.
  • Text contrast was improved a little in both themes so small text is easier to read.

Beta 1.0.0 · 2026-11-01

Build 8

A TestFlight internal test build, not released to the public yet.

  • New: a small Release Notes link at the bottom of the first screen. It opens the Claimball website's page about what changed in each version.
  • The link opens in your browser and is shown in English for now.

Beta 1.0.0 · 2026-11-01

Build 7

A TestFlight internal test build, not released to the public yet.

  • Continue on another device (iPhone and iPad): your progress, stars, achievements, the free-trial state and your accessibility settings now follow your iCloud account. It works quietly in the background, and if iCloud is off or offline the game simply keeps its own copy on the device.
  • Not shared through iCloud: the Full Unlock purchase (the App Store keeps track of that), the Daily Challenge attempt, and vibration and sound settings.
  • If a Full Unlock purchase is refunded or taken back through Family Sharing, the game locks again, and it is careful not to lock by mistake when you are signed out or offline.
  • If the app closes in the middle of a Daily Challenge, you get that day's one attempt back. Leaving to the menu on purpose still uses it up.
  • The system Back gesture or button during a Daily Challenge now pauses and resumes the match, and from other screens takes you back to the menu instead of closing the app.
  • Android purchase support was prepared in the same update; Android is not available yet.

Beta 1.0.0 · 2026-10-31

Build 6

A TestFlight internal test build, not released to the public yet.

  • Full Unlock: try the game free, then make one purchase to unlock everything. It is a one-time purchase, with no subscription and no ads. The price is shown by the store in your own currency.
  • Restore Purchases is in Settings, and purchases waiting for approval (Ask to Buy) are handled. The unlock offer appears only at calm moments, such as after a win, and never pushes you.
  • Daily Challenge rematches were re-balanced so the toughest pairings are no longer nearly impossible or nearly automatic.
  • Requires iOS 15 or later.

Beta 1.0.0 · 2026-10-31

Build 5

A TestFlight internal test build, not released to the public yet.

  • Six AI rivals, each with their own style, in two leagues. Beat one to unlock the next. Your progress is saved.
  • Rivals now react with faces and little movements when they enter, score, get scored on, are surprised, win or lose.
  • Combo chains: the sound and the haptic buzz step up at 3, 5, 8 and 12 hits in a row. In the last 20 seconds a Fever mode adds a warmer screen tone, bouncing tiles and a quick beep, with the rules unchanged.
  • Each match earns 1 to 3 stars, your best stars show on each rival's card, and there is a list of achievements.
  • Daily Challenge: one match a day with a twist from five variants.
  • New setting, Color-blind patterns: dots on your tiles and stripes on the opponent's.
  • Fixed overlapping sound effects. Mirror, the toughest rival, is a little easier.

Beta 1.0.0 · 2026-10-31

Build 4

A TestFlight internal test build, not released to the public yet.

  • A new opening: an intro screen with a short "pop" sound, a redesigned menu and a redesigned results screen.
  • Score chips on the match screen were tidied up.
  • New setting: Sound On/Off (on by default). The intro sound is made for the game.

Beta 1.0.0 · 2026-10-31

Build 3

A TestFlight internal test build, not released to the public yet.

  • A softer, toy-like look: rounded, glossy tiles, a new ball and paddle, and a fresh court. The scoreboard and overlays match.
  • Now in nine languages: English, Korean, Japanese, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, German and French. Longer words no longer spill out of their boxes.
  • Your paddle hit now gives a small vibration (lighter for a normal hit, firmer for a smash). You can turn it off in Settings.
  • The board now keeps a little margin on both sides and room for its shadow on small phones.

Beta 1.0.0 · 2026-10-31

Build 2

A TestFlight internal test build, not released to the public yet.

  • Claimball now has its app icon.
  • A pause button during a match (also Esc or P on a keyboard) with Resume, Restart and Quit.
  • Fixed items overlapping on some screens.

Beta 1.0.0 · 2026-10-31

Build 1

A TestFlight internal test build, not released to the public yet.

  • The first playable build: a 90-second match on a grid of tiles. Hit the ball to paint tiles your color, and be first to claim 30 or hold more tiles when time runs out.
  • A marker shows where the ball will land. Fill the smash gauge by keeping the rally going to paint a wide strip at once.
  • A tie goes to sudden death: the next point wins. If a ball is still in the air at 90 seconds, the match waits for it to land.
  • The game pauses automatically when you leave the app. Drag, keyboard and touch controls are supported.

Last updated: 2026-11-12
